name: prac-vscode-embed
description: The embeddable wrapper over the Code - OSS build `prac-vscode` produces: a host half (same-origin asset serving + code-server HTTP/WS proxy) and a browser half (boot the app once per page, host its parts in containers the embedder owns, carry its theme classes and command namespace). It knows nothing about prac or DSH — routes, ports, workspace paths and which part backs which view stay in the consumer.
